  • Verdict: HOLD — Medium conviction. Valuation (34.4x trailing / 39.6x fwd PE) already prices a multi-year growth reacceleration that isn't confirmed yet. Fact · Yahoo · 2026-09-02.

  • 12-mo price target: $350 (base), prob-weighted expected return ≈ +6% (see scenarios) — below what a growth mandate should demand from a new position.
  • Buy zone: $260–290. Do-not-chase above: $340.
  • Position size: 0–3% starter only on weakness — not a fresh full-size growth position at current price.
